# tpuf_namespace (Resource)

Manages a turbopuffer namespace: its existence, attribute schema, and pinning configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tpuf_namespace" "docs" {
  name = "docs"

  schema = {
    text = {
      type             = "string"
      full_text_search = true
    }
    embedding = {
      type = "[1536]f32"
      ann  = true
    }
    source = {
      type       = "string"
      filterable = true
    }
  }

  pinning_replicas = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The namespace name. Changing this forces a new namespace.

### Optional

- `pinning_replicas` (Number) Number of warm read replicas to pin for this namespace. Omit to disable pinning.
- `schema` (Attributes Map) Attribute schema for documents in this namespace, keyed by attribute name. The built-in `id` attribute is managed by turbopuffer and excluded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schema))

### Read-Only

- `approx_row_count` (Number) Approximate number of rows currently in the namespace.

<a id="nestedatt--schema"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schema`

Required:

- `type` (String) Attribute data type, e.g. string, int, bool, [1536]f32.

Optional:

- `ann` (Boolean) Whether an approximate nearest neighbor index is built for the attribute.
- `filterable` (Boolean) Whether the attribute can be used in filters.
- `full_text_search` (Boolean) Whether the attribute is indexed for BM25 full-text search.
- `glob` (Boolean) Whether glob filters are enabled on the attribute.
- `regex` (Boolean) Whether regex filters are enabled on the attribute.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Namespaces are imported by name.
terraform import tpuf_namespace.docs docs
```
